independence.duplicate_check: Existing hermes run was inspected only to avoid selecting the same SHA/mechanism; all case evidence below was re-read from Git commit^/commit diffs and tests.

scope: Real compaction/context-pressure/shared-capacity changes with before/after code, call sites and committed tests. Four mechanisms are kept distinct.

cases.case_action: When an auxiliary model's context window binds the compaction threshold, subtract the actual tool-schema estimate plus a conservative system/flush reserve before installing the threshold; clamp to the minimum viable context.
cases.subject: fix(compression): reserve system+tools headroom when aux binds threshold (#15631)
call_points: auxiliary compression summarizer and flush_memories request path

before_after.after: tool_overhead = estimate_request_tokens_rough([], tools=self.tools); headroom = tool_overhead + 12000; new_threshold = max(aux_context - headroom, MINIMUM_CONTEXT_LENGTH)

cases.problem: The raw message threshold and the auxiliary provider request shared one finite context window, but system prompt, tool schemas and flush instructions were omitted from the threshold.
evidence: Commit message reports 25-30K token overhead with 50+ tools and HTTP 400 on compression/flush.
Diff replaces direct aux_context assignment with tool estimate + 12K reserve + minimum floor.
Regression test asserts threshold < 128000 with 50 tool schemas and threshold >= MINIMUM_CONTEXT_LENGTH.
Floor test asserts heavy tools do not push installed threshold below MINIMUM_CONTEXT_LENGTH.
Existing expected thresholds change 80000->68000 and 99999->87999, showing static reserve applies even with empty tools.

cases.case_action: Before child results enter the parent transcript, divide the parent's residual input headroom across the batch, combine that dynamic cap with a static safety ceiling, and spill the full text so trimming is lossless.
cases.subject: fix(delegation): budget subagent summaries against parent context headroom
cases.related_reference: PR #9126 (named in the new test module docstring)
call_points: parent context injection after summary budgeting

before_after.before: Each child final_response was returned verbatim; no batch-wide parent headroom calculation or lossless spill.
before_after.after: headroom_tokens = context_length - used_tokens - reserved; batch_token_budget = fraction * headroom; per_summary_tokens = batch_token_budget // n; effective cap = min(dynamic cap, delegation.max_summary_chars); oversized summaries become head+tail+read_file footer with full text spilled.

cases.problem: N child summaries could be inserted simultaneously and overflow the parent's context, causing compression/429 death spirals.
evidence: Commit message reports 60K+ fan-out output and explains that full text is preserved in cache.
Config adds delegation.max_summary_chars=24000 with 0 disabling only the static ceiling.
delegate_task invokes _apply_summary_budget for both single-task and batch results.
The trim path preserves both opening and closing content and gives an exact read_file offset.

cases.case_action: Make dynamic summary budgeting consume the receiving aggregator's current prompt usage, reject unknown usage as unknown (static ceiling only), and avoid cumulative session or MoA-advisor tokens.

commits.subject: fix(delegate): nested orchestrators get their workers' results back — no 420 s deadline on delegate_task, summary budget uses the current prompt not the session sum
fix(delegation): summary headroom uses the aggregator's own prompt size; unknown usage means the static ceiling, never zero context

before_after.before: Budget read session_prompt_tokens / cumulative session sum; first no-usage state was treated as 0; MoA folded advisor usage could represent tokens not present in aggregator context.
before_after.after: record_response_usage stores aggregator_usage.prompt_tokens as _last_prompt_size_tokens; _parent_prompt_size_tokens prefers that, falls back to last provider prompt usage, and returns None when unknown; None makes caller use static ceiling only.

cases.problem: A budget formula can be numerically correct yet unsafe if its usage input is cumulative, foreign to the receiver, or falsely known as zero.
evidence: 903 commit reports 1,393 child summaries all collapsed to 2,000-char floor when session sum exceeded any context window.
091 commit gives a concrete 190K/200K parent with no usage row receiving an approximately 384K-char dynamic budget under the old zero default.
091 adds _last_prompt_size_tokens from aggregator_usage before MoA folding and keeps last-turn fallback.
Unknown usage now returns None, preserving the static ceiling instead of inventing zero used tokens.
cases.scope_note: The same 903 commit also exempts nested delegate_task from a generic sequential deadline. That liveness fix is recorded as adjacent evidence, not treated as the context-capacity mechanism.

cases.case_action: For small windows, raise only the implicit compaction trigger floor, remove the summary wire hard cap that truncates thinking output, strip recursive reasoning traces, and block repeated no-op compactions until progress is possible.
cases.subject: fix(compression): stop compaction thrash — 75% trigger floor under 512K, no summary output cap, reasoning-trace exclusion (#60989)

before_after.before: Sub-512K models used the default 50% trigger; summary ceiling was 12000 and wire max_tokens could truncate thinking summaries; inline reasoning traces could be re-fed into iterative summaries.
before_after.after: For context_length < 512000, effective threshold percent is max(configured, 0.75); summary ceiling is 10000 with no summary max_tokens wire cap; inline/native reasoning is excluded before serialization and output trace is stripped before storage; repeated no-op compression is guarded.

cases.problem: Compression fired every 1-2 turns because the incompressible floor consumed reclaimed headroom, and summary truncation/trace feedback made the compression result fail to reduce future pressure.
evidence: Commit message explicitly identifies the 50% trigger plus system/tools/protected tail/rolling summary as the thrash mechanism.
_effective_threshold_percent is raise-only and re-applied in both construction and model switching.
Diff removes max_tokens from summary wire kwargs and lowers the summary envelope to 1K-10K.
Infinite-loop tests require meaningful compressible middle and suppress should_compress after two ineffective passes.

cross_case_relations.relation: both derive an upstream limit from capacity consumed by downstream material, but consumers differ
the latter repairs the input measurement used by the former

excluded_similar_cases.reason: UI percentage cap and provider-usage estimator; display/telemetry contract rather than capacity admission or compaction progress
delegation worker concurrency capacity, not model context capacity
compression generation/ownership race and concurrent publication, not shared-capacity arithmetic
lossless tool-output densification; reduces representation size but does not implement a pressure policy
